notes:
## New features
- A persistent update window keeps release notes, download progress, verification and the restart action together.

## Changes
- A cleaner changelog groups new features, changes and bug fixes, showing only sections with content.
- Check for Updates also shows the current release notes when you are already up to date.
- The bottom-left activity indicator and message have more space from the window edge.
- Downloads continue when you close the update window; reopen it to review progress or install when ready.

## Bug fixes
- The update badge opens the discovered update immediately instead of silently repeating a network check.
- A manual update request made during a background check now opens the result window.
- Empty changelog headings and legacy “None in this release” placeholders are hidden.
